narrative.overview: A shared dark working frame gives administrators, security personnel and students equal care. Charcoal surfaces, warm white text and muted yellow-green actions establish a quiet operational hierarchy. Compact data and controls sit inside generous page spacing; plate identifiers provide the distinctive visual anchor.
keyCharacteristics: Fixed dark palette and thin rules
One responsive frame for three equally considered roles
Short state transitions with reduced-motion support

rules.name: Flat working surfaces
rules.body: Use tonal layers and thin borders for operational panels. Reserve the illustrated shadow for the login recognition preview.

rules.name: Readable status
rules.body: Pair status color with readable text.

dos: Do preserve equal care for all roles and visible demo labeling.
Do retain keyboard focus, mobile navigation and reduced-motion support.
Do preserve the original SVG logo and the Manrope OFL license.
donts: Do not add a light-mode switch to the fixed-dark implementation.
Do not claim the authored SVG schematic is verified geography or per-space sensing.
Do not imply unsupported authentication or live-camera capabilities.
